integrity: Analytical proof supplemented by reproducible finite exact and numerical checks; no assertion of independent validation, originality certification, or stochastic prediction.
scientific_limitations: Finite directed chains with positive predation coefficients and common mortality-to-reproduction ratio strictly between zero and one; deterministic occupancy mean-field equations only. No claim for cyclic, spatial, noisy, or dynamically recruited species, or heterogeneous break-even thresholds.
title: Global alternating-survival law for a hierarchical vacancy-limited community
